description.value: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.
A black marble chanfron, set with a large solitaire diamond and finished with glossy paint in brightly colors.
Your Strength score is 19 while you wear these gauntlets. They have no effect on you if your Strength is 19 or higher without them.

For 1 minute after you drink this potion, you have Resistance to all damage.

This potion's syrupy liquid looks like liquefied iron.
